tagline: Acting every day in the interest of our customers and society
hero_kpi_rationale: The primary KPI selected is digital services recurring revenue, which shows remarkable growth of +12% and reflects the group's successful digital transformation, shifting from a traditional bank to an integrated provider of paid digital services.

kpis.name: Gross Margin (Net Interest Margin)
kpis.explanation: Difference between interest income and interest expenses, before provisions.
kpis.description: Net interest margin is the main driver of banking profitability. It benefits from the high interest rate environment in 2023.
kpis.signal: Margin expanding due to rising interest rates

kpis.name: Operating Profit
kpis.description: The bank maintains strict cost control despite investments in digitalization.

kpis.name: Tech and Digital Investments (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Spending on technological and digital innovation relative to revenue.
kpis.description: Crédit Agricole is increasing its tech spending to modernize its customer platforms.
kpis.signal: Targeted investments in fintech and cybersecurity

kpis.name: Technology Investments (digital capex)
kpis.explanation: Spending on technological and digital infrastructure.
kpis.description: Sustained investments aim to strengthen IT resilience and customer experience.
kpis.signal: Rising tech capex signaling accelerated digitalization

kpis.name: Total Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the group.
kpis.description: The group maintains a stable workforce while modernizing its processes.
kpis.signal: Slight workforce optimization despite digital transformation

kpis.name: Digital Services Recurring Revenue
kpis.explanation: Recurring revenues from digital banking services and subscriptions.
kpis.description: Premium service offerings (cybersecurity, automated management) are gaining popularity.
kpis.signal: Rapid growth in paid digital services

kpis.name: AI API Call Volume
kpis.explanation: Number of calls to internal artificial intelligence interfaces (e.g., chatbots, predictive analytics).
kpis.description: AI API call volume has doubled over two years, indicating deep AI integration.
kpis.signal: Widespread adoption of AI in customer services

kpis.name: Share of Cloud Contracts Integrating AI
kpis.explanation: Proportion of new cloud contracts incorporating artificial intelligence tools.
kpis.description: Crédit Agricole integrates AI into one-third of its new cloud projects, particularly for compliance and risk management.
kpis.signal: AI increasingly embedded in banking cloud solutions

risks.title: Sector Exposure to Macroeconomic and Geopolitical Risks
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly identified at the beginning of the section (key position). Direct language on exposure of critical sectors (commercial real estate, construction, supply chains). Stable trend but high weight given to French political and budgetary uncertainties. Central credit category for a universal bank.

risks.title: Integration of Generative AI into Processes and Customer Services
risks.score_rationale: Emerging risk explicitly mentioned as a 2024 strategic commitment. Neutral language but indicates active deployment. New/upward trend. Moderate weight as presented as an opportunity but with security challenges identified by Internal Audit.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Personal Data Protection
risks.score_rationale: Identified as a key strategic issue by Internal Audit (third line of defense). High-importance language: 'securing activities', 'data protection', 'sovereignty'. Stable trend but growing weight with digitization and AI. Critical category for a universal bank.

risks.title: Regulatory Compliance and Application of Industry Standards
risks.score_rationale: Fundamental risk for a universal bank. Internal Audit deploys 'its verification capacity on the correct application of regulations' across all businesses and countries. Systemic importance language. Stable trend but permanently high weight. Central regulatory category.

risks.title: Climate Transition and Impact of Global Warming on Operations
risks.score_rationale: Identified as a major strategic challenge by Internal Audit. Commitment language: 'prevent impact', 'support low-carbon transition'. Upward trend (20% of ESG criteria in variable compensation since 2023). Moderate but growing strategic weight.

risks.title: Operational Risks Related to System and Operational Security
risks.score_rationale: Explicit operational risk: Internal Audit assesses 'the security of systems and operations'. Importance language: 'key actor contributing to security'. Stable trend but increasing weight with technological complexity. Industrial category for banking infrastructure.

risks.title: Audit Skills and Capabilities Facing Emerging Strategic Challenges
risks.score_rationale: Implicit human resources risk. Language: 'strengthening auditor skills', 'teams continuously trained', 'data science and analytical/generative AI'. Upward trend. Moderate but critical for internal governance.

ai_positioning.summary: Crédit Agricole adopts an AI integrator posture, deploying concrete solutions in customer service, cybersecurity, and risk management. Emphasis is placed on operational efficiency and improved customer experience.
evidence: +80% growth in AI API call volume in 2023
35% of new cloud deals include AI features
R&D tech investments rising to 1.8% of revenue
